QuestInfo.name: [Aqua Road] The Lost Expedition
QuestInfo.0: Taeng the Explorer has been looking for traces of his lost diving team in the Deep Sea for a long time.
QuestInfo.1: Getting back some of the team's items invigorated him, but no one was ever found. He hands you the three items and asks you to investigate them. Maybe Wiz the Librarian will be able to restore this illegible note.
QuestInfo.2: You met Wiz the Librarian in the Helios Tower Library and asked about restoring the note.
